question: Regarding urinary incontinence, point out the FALSE answer:

options.opa: In urinary stress incontinence, a precipitating factor is physical exercise.
options.opb: In urgency incontinence, the urinary frequency is normal.
options.opc: The most reliable test to establish an accurate diagnosis of the type of incontinence is the urodynamic study.
options.opd: In the treatment of emergency urinary incontinence, anticholinergic drugs are used.
